claims.text: Participant P-02 recorded resting heart rate values such as 57.2 bpm on trial day 1 and 55.7 bpm on trial day 27.
Subjective fatigue scores ranged between 3.0 and 5.0 throughout the observation window.
Physiological wearable data is missing for several days in the middle of the observation window, specifically around trial days 8 through 14 and days 22 through 23.
No clear correlation between daily strain levels and subjective fatigue scores is evident across the reporting period.
The safety signal remains low and stable, though continuous monitoring is limited by periods of missing wearable metrics.
